description: This file defines the GLShape class, which manages graphical shape objects composed of faces and vertices within a 3D rendering context for an Android OpenGL application. It includes methods for adding faces, setting face colors, managing vertices, performing transformations, and handling animations.

classes.name: GLShape
classes.description: A class representing a 3D shape composed of faces and vertices, capable of managing its geometry and preparing it for rendering in an OpenGL context.

methods.name: GLShape
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shape with a reference to the GLWorld.

methods.name: addFace
methods.description: Adds a face to the shape.

methods.name: setFaceColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a specified face.

methods.name: putIndices
methods.description: Writes all face indices into the provided buffer.

methods.name: getIndexCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of indices used by all faces.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex with specified coordinates; reuses existing vertex if identical coordinates are found.

methods.name: animateTransform
methods.description: Applies a transformation to the shape's vertices for animation.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Placeholder for starting an animation sequence.

methods.name: endAnimation
methods.description: Finalizes the current transformation, setting up for the next animation cycle.
